To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PROPER, a national level public reporting program, can be a powerful regulatory tool in promoting pollution control and improving environmental management.

PROPER has had significant impact on shifting factories from non compliance to compliance, has increased voluntary participation in the program, has increased awareness regarding pollution control and environmental issues, has helped promote an integrated environmental management system, and has exerted pressure on the government agency to improve its methodology and refine its processes to ensure that the ratings are trustworthy.
PROPER has had positive results and is a useful tool for promoting pollution control in Indonesia.
